nonclaims: This packet corrects the earlier statement that all internal testnet signing helpers were reachable only through direct-call fixtures. Before this correction, the sealed-bid local-ledger submitter could be mounted by configuration.
The common field-name scanner remains a defense-in-depth denylist over ASCII names. It is not a substitute for route-specific closed typed request decoders.
AutoTrader live writes are deliberately unavailable through normal API-server startup. External signing for both DEX intent envelopes and the Tau transaction remains to be implemented and verified.
Confidential sealed-bid commit and reveal behavior is outside this correction. Only the local-ledger settlement adapter with fixture signing authority is prevented from mounting.
Direct Python fixture helpers and manually constructed test servers remain outside normal API-server startup and carry no production or settlement authority.
This packet proves no economic conservation, signer non-extractability, whole-economy recursion, deployment finality, or safety of all value movement.
